SignalForge pitch
Working demoPDFEditable PowerPoint
Slide 1 text

SignalForge brings prediction-market evidence into bonding-curve rehearsal. This working prototype uses synthetic Panta data and real Meteora SDK calculations.

Slide 2 text

Launch teams need to see how assumptions change actual fills. Panta detail and recent trades provide market evidence. Operators define the YES budget of 40,000 USDC and NO budget of 8,000 USDC. The demo invents the event and activity. Market prices cannot establish token demand.

Slide 3 text

Capture authenticated Panta reads with bounded catalog pages, detail and trade snapshots. Assess active phase, freshness, volume, activity and price complement. Simulate three configurations with official Meteora SDK 1.5.13. Export HTML, quote CSV, inputs, configurations and replayable JSON. Every quote starts from the same empty pool and simulation stops at migration.

Slide 4 text

At an initial cap of 20,000 USDC, migration cap of 200,000 USDC and 1% fixed fee: constant liquidity consumes 40,000 USDC, charges 400 USDC, leaves 0 unused and reaches 82.4% migration progress. Front-weighted liquidity consumes 38,870.109491, charges 388.701095, leaves 1,129.890509 unused and reaches migration. Back-weighted liquidity consumes 40,000, charges 400, leaves 0 unused and reaches 67.0%. These are real SDK calculations on hypothetical inputs.

Slide 5 text

23 tests pass. Checks cover exact input/fee conservation, an independent integer quote equation, missing/stale evidence, API failures and altered reports. Run npm ci, npm test and npm run demo. Full replay matches the saved report. Browser checks cover chart switching and scenario details.

Slide 6 text

Pending: an authorized Panta key, relevant live market and fresh capture. A human entrant must review eligibility, register and submit. Launch-team feedback and mainnet traction remain unproven. There is no claimed adoption, prize, live capture, or official entry.
